description: Resumable production-finalization tracker for the shared-features npm package + its new companion docs site. First phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on.
type: npm-package (React/Capacitor shared components, hooks, services, types, notifications)

verifyGates.package: yarn typecheck (exit 0) + yarn lint (exit 0) + yarn build (ESM+CJS+d.ts, exit 0)

userDecisions.publishIsUserOnly: npm publish is USER-ONLY (never run by agent)
userDecisions.consumerTemplatesAreIntentional: src/templates/consumer/* TODO/placeholder markers are BY DESIGN — copy-paste templates for consuming apps to fill in; NOT package gaps
userDecisions.comingSoonFeatures: README 'Available Features' Coming-Soon rows (contactInfo, developerInfo, socialLinks, etc.) are RUNTIME admin-panel flag states, not code gaps — the commonFeatures service/hook/types already support them

knownRisks: firebase pinned at 12.x major + zustand at major 5 (intentional holds — do not bump silently)
Ad variant components use dangerouslySetInnerHTML for admin-controlled SVG icon64 (existing infra; not new code)

gapInventory.title: AdPanel `variant` prop was a documented no-op
gapInventory.evidence: src/components/ads/AdPanel.tsx:29 had `// TODO: variant will be used...`; README documents `<AdPanel placement="sidebar_panel" variant="small_panel_2" />` but the prop was renamed `_variant` and ignored.
gapInventory.resolution: Wired AdPanel to render via getSmallPanelVariant(variant || campaign.variant || 'small_panel_2'), mirroring AdSlider. Removed the no-op TODO and AdPanel's own duplicated dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Build/typecheck/lint green; components bundle shrank.

gapInventory.title: README 'Current State' block stale (claimed v0.1.13, verified 2026-03-24)
gapInventory.evidence: README.md lines 7-15 claim version 0.1.13 + 2026-03-24; package.json is 0.1.14.
gapInventory.resolution: Refreshed README Current State to v0.1.14 / 2026-06-23 and pointed to the new docs site.

gapInventory.title: No companion documentation site
gapInventory.evidence: Package had only README + AI-INTEGRATION-GUIDE; no Docusaurus docs site / no shared-features-docs repo.
gapInventory.resolution: Created shared-features-docs (NEW PUBLIC Docusaurus 3 site) from native-update-docs template; full API/component/hook/service reference authored source-accurate.

gapInventory.title: Consumer templates contain TODO/placeholder markers
gapInventory.evidence: src/templates/consumer/* (notificationsStore.template.ts, useOneSignal.template.ts, NotificationBell.template.tsx, etc.) contain `// TODO: Implement with your notification service` / placeholder data.
gapInventory.resolution: These are copy-paste consumer templates excluded from tsc; the placeholders are the intended fill-in points for consuming apps. Filling them in the package would be wrong.

gapInventory.title: npm publish of any version bump
gapInventory.evidence: Publishing requires npm auth + maintainer decision.

phases.title: Privacy gate + env/secret scan
phases.note: Package repo PRIVATE; only website/.env.example present (no real secrets); no keystores/.firebaserc to force-add.

phases.title: Build automatable gaps (AdPanel variant + README refresh)
Finalize: verify gates + sync both repos

runHistory.summary: Discovered stack (npm package: 6 entrypoints, Radix UI ads/notifications/common, 4 hooks, 7 services, event system + consumer templates; in-repo marketing website/). Verified package green. Fixed AdPanel variant no-op (GAP-1). Refreshed README. Created shared-features-docs PUBLIC Docusaurus site. Wrote MANUAL-TASKS.

resumeInstructions: 1) Read this tracker. 2) All phases complete as of 2026-06-23. 3) Only outstanding work is USER-ONLY (npm publish + docs deploy) in docs/MANUAL-TASKS.md. 4) On re-run: verify package gates (typecheck/lint/build) + docs build still green; bump lastUpdated.
